name: Does the Denver climate affect kitchen tile floor installation?

mainEntity.name: Does the Denver climate affect kitchen tile floor installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Denver metro area, homes experience significant seasonal humidity swings, shifting from arid winters to humid summer storms. These environmental changes cause subfloors, wall studs, and joists to expand and contract. For kitchen tile floors, using an uncoupling membrane beneath the tile prevents movement in the subfloor from translating into cracked tiles or crumbling grout lines. Installers also leave proper perimeter expansion joints along walls and baseboards so the tile field has room to shift naturally without tenting or lifting under local climate conditions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Local seasonal humidity changes cause framing movement. Using uncoupling membranes and perimeter expansion gaps prevents tiles and grout from cracking.
